row: I'm Pankaj Goswami, a licensed chiropractor passionate about helping my patients lead healthier and pain-free lives. Having a Master diploma in chiropractic therapy, Master diploma in cupping therapy and with 7 years of experience in the field, I've had the privilege of treating a wide range of conditions and helping people of all ages. On my channel, I'll be sharing tips, exercises, and advice to help you live your best life without pain. From neck and back pain to headaches and migraines, I'll be discussing various issues and the latest techniques to alleviate them. Whether you're a patient or just looking to learn more about chiropractic care, this channel is for you. Subscribe and join me on this journey to better health and wellness. Let's get started!"
